title: fix(plugin-detail): retire the contract-refused `aria.label` fold on `record:path` and `record:quick_actions`
body:
Fixes #9945
Clause-②: no

Carries out ruling `5749677059` on objectui#9945 (letter A, maintainer 「同意」). The shared `record:*` aria read point now reads `aria.ariaLabel` only. `record:path` and `record:quick_actions` no longer fold in the contract-refused `aria.label`. A served `aria.label` on those two blocks is reported, and the block announces its default name.

## What changed

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordComponentAria.ts` | `useRecordAriaName` returns `resolveI18nLabel(aria?.ariaLabel, locale)`; the `legacyLabelFold` option is gone. A `block` option takes its place: when the caller names its block and the bag carries `label`, one `console.warn` names the block and `aria.ariaLabel`. `AuthoredRecordAria.label` stays, only so the report can see the key without an `as any` cast; its docblock says so. The module header's fold paragraphs are rewritten. |
| `record-path.tsx`, `record-quick-actions.tsx` | `legacyLabelFold: true` becomes `block: 'record:path'` / `block: 'record:quick_actions'`. The comments that described the fold are rewritten. |
| `__tests__/recordAriaLabelRetired-9945.test.tsx` (new) | Five rows per block, listed under Pins. |
| `__tests__/record-quick-actions.ariaLabel.test.tsx` | The objectui#4663 pin is rewritten, ⛔ not deleted. It now asserts the retirement, and its comment gives the reason. |
| `__tests__/recordComponentAria-9556.test.tsx`, `__tests__/record-path.containerLabel.test.tsx` | Rows that asserted the fold now assert the retirement. The container-label override row authors the canonical spelling. |
| `packages/types/src/record-components.ts` | Docblock only: the paragraph that said two renderers read `label` now says none does. |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/useDetailTranslation.ts` | Comment only: the `detail.pathLabel` note named `aria.label` as the author override. |
| `.changeset/9945-record-aria-label-retired.md` (new), `.changeset/9556-record-component-aria-honoured.md` | New entry: `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/types`. The pending objectui#9556 entry gets a dated note in the objectui#10533 form. |

## The ruling's condition, measured first

The ruling allowed A only if each block has a default accessible name when no `ariaLabel` is authored. Otherwise B was to land. Both blocks have one:

| Block | Where its default comes from | Measured with nothing authored |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `record:path` | `defaultLabel: t('detail.pathLabel')`, the pack entry; `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` serves `'Record path'` with no provider | `'Record path'` on both rails (en); zh, de and ja names in `record-path.containerLabel.test.tsx` |
| `record:quick_actions` | `defaultLabel: 'Quick actions'`, a literal this block does not translate today | `'Quick actions'` |

So B's trigger did not fire, and A landed. The measurement is the row "has a default accessible name when nothing is authored (the ruling's condition)" in the new pin file.

## Two choices, with the evidence

**Channel: `console.warn` from an effect keyed on the message.** Enumerated over `packages/plugin-detail/src` (non-test `console.warn` / `console.error` sites):

- The row-cap refusal is `describeRefusedFeedLimit` in `record:activity`, `record:chatter` and `record:history`, and the reference rail's `describeRefusedRowLimit`. It is `console.warn`, fired from an effect keyed on the message. It covers a declaration the spec refuses: the block ignores it and uses its default, the same shape as this case. objectui#10097 is the "always warn" answer for that family.
- The other shape is `console.error` from a module-level reported-once `Set`: the unresolved section group in `record-details.tsx`, and the refused action array in `record-quick-actions.tsx`. That file's own comment says why it chose error: "this bar draws NONE of its authored actions". Here the block keeps rendering, with its default name, so it is the warn case.
- The effect-keyed channel has no module state, so it needs no reset test seam, which means no new export of any kind.
- ⚠️ This differs from the dispatch's wording "once per block type". It fires once per mounted block, and a re-render says nothing. The rerender row pins that.

**Scope: the report fires on the two blocks, not all seven.** The dispatching seat read "the read point" as every block. I chose the two, because:

1. The card says "⛔ The other five blocks are not part of this question". The ruling's heading is "retire the `aria.label` fold on `record:path` and `record:quick_actions`".
2. The diagnostic bullet ends "The block's accessible name falls back to its default name". Only these two pass a `defaultLabel`. The five call `useRecordAriaProps(schema.aria)` with no options.
3. The ruling's facet ② says "the diagnostic is what makes A's cost visible where it occurs". A's cost is a stored document silently losing its name. That only happens where the alias was read in a release, which means these two. The five never read `aria.label` in a release: before objectui#9935 they read nothing, and objectui#9935 as merged kept the fold off them (its changeset is still pending).
4. To name the block, the name has to come from the call site. Covering the five means editing five renderer files outside the claim's file surface.

The refusal itself holds on all seven blocks and is pinned on all seven. Adding the report to the five would be one argument per call site, if wanted.

## Pins

`recordAriaLabelRetired-9945.test.tsx` runs these rows for each of `record:path` and `record:quick_actions`, through `getByRole(role, { name })`:

- nothing authored: the default name, and no report (the ruling's condition);
- `{ aria: { label: 'Legacy name' } }`: the default name, and nothing is named `Legacy name`;
- the same bag, rendered and then re-rendered: exactly one report, and it contains the block name and `` `aria.ariaLabel` ``;
- control, `{ aria: { ariaLabel: 'Account overview', label: 'Legacy name' } }`: named `Account overview`, and the refused key is still reported once;
- control, `{ aria: { ariaLabel: 'Account overview' } }`: named, and no report.

## Ablation (one-time proof, ⛔ no permanent test file)

Every leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack `scripts/`) at `cc60d6df8`. Each checked its anchor count and blob change on disk, and each was restored to the HEAD blob `e8a0df0a6174` with `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported by relative path from `src/`, so there is no `dist/` in the loop.

- **Leg 2, the fold restored exactly as it was, on the two named blocks:** `resolveI18nLabel(block ? aria?.ariaLabel ?? aria?.label : aria?.ariaLabel, locale)`. `Tests 5 failed | 60 passed (65)`. The five red rows are exactly the retirement rows: the rewritten objectui#4663 pin, the new file's "not read" row for each block, and the two rewritten objectui#9556 rows. Every canonical control stayed green, and so did the five-block absences.
- **Leg 1, the fold restored for every caller** (run at `af12ef9d6`): 10 red. That adds the five-block absence rows in the objectui#9556 file, which confirms they still guard the objectui#9935 scoping.
- **Leg 3, report silenced:** 5 red, all of them report assertions. **Leg 4, report fired on every render (effect deps dropped):** 2 red, the "reported once" row for each block.

## Gates (head `cc60d6df8`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` from the repo root: `Test Files 210 passed | 1 skipped (211)`, `Tests 2076 passed | 8 skipped (2084)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` (at `17bb0ebb3`, where `packages/types` is the same as at this head): `236 passed (236)`, `5223 passed (5223)`.
- Closure: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2`, 11 successful out of 11. The rebuilt `packages/types/dist/record-components.d.ts` carries the new docblock.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` exit 0, with the script echoing `@object-ui/plugin-detail@17.6.0 type-check`. Its `tsconfig.test.json` compiles the new pin: the first run went red on two TS7006 errors in it. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0.
- Also exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the objectui#9556 edit as a prose correction with its front matter unchanged (its case 2, report-only).
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, report-only: before the objectui#9556 note, 3 pending entries named a touched file (`7182-declared-action-ids-one-rule`, `9280-record-highlights-entry-icon-retired`, `9556-record-component-aria-honoured`); after it, 2. I read both remaining paragraphs and both still hold: they are about `resolveDeclaredActionIds` and the highlights `icon` member. The self-contradiction reading passes. ⚠️ The false sentence in objectui#9556 ("gains no reader and loses none") names no file, so the gate could never have flagged it. It is the objectui#9140 blind spot, and it was found by reading.
- Also exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:vi-mock-specifiers`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over all 11 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 9 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 9 files in the report, 0 errors. Per-rule warning counts equal base on all 8 files that already existed (base read by `--stdin` from `50e41f738`). The new file has 0 warnings. `eslint.config.js` has no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so no verdict on an untouched file can move.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface beyond the claim, with reasons.** The claim named `recordComponentAria.ts`, the two call-site arguments, the pins and one changeset. This diff also touches:
  - the comments beside those two arguments, and the `aria` prop docblock in `record-quick-actions.tsx`, all of which described the fold;
  - the `record-components.ts` docblock, which ships in `@object-ui/types`' `.d.ts` and this change would make false;
  - one comment in `useDetailTranslation.ts`, for the same reason;
  - the pending objectui#9556 changeset, the first form the dispatch's own item 5 offered.

  The five container renderers are ⛔ not touched (see "Scope").
- A stored document that still carries `aria.label` on these two blocks now announces the default name. It is not re-routed into `ariaLabel`: that would be the tolerant alias this retirement removes.
- Observation, not filed: `@object-ui/core`'s `normalizeListViewSchema` still carries an `ARIA_KEY_ALIASES` fold (`label` becomes `ariaLabel`) at the ListView boundary. It is a separate surface (objectui#2890's vocabulary bridge) and outside this card.
- objectui#4663's pin is superseded for `record:quick_actions` by this ruling. The rewritten pin's header states the reason: the standing rule that a deprecated alias retires at once, with staging only on named external-user evidence.

The session behind this change is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC` (`domain:ui` seat 1, claim `5831103778`).
